exact_prompt:
Generate ONE original professional hand-painted side-view 2D action-platformer game environment cutout on genuinely transparent alpha. Native landscape 3:2 CANVAS; this is a canvas format, not the silhouette aspect ratio. The whole artwork is a wide, low architectural band situated in the lower half of that canvas, with generous truly transparent air above. Preserve complete outline and both full grounded feet with clear transparent outer padding; no cropping or invented scenery/background.

Subject: a complete abandoned open-air mechanical TUNING COURT behind a broad grassy boss arena. TWO asymmetrical monumental flank structures enclose a huge tranquil OPEN CENTER. This is a continuous spatial composition, not a prop sheet: left is a tall weather-worn limestone compression fin, its exposed split revealing quiet dark laminated timber and a few dull copper pressure plates; right is a lower broader crumbled buttress with three strongly sloping stone ribs and old wooden load braces. The left and right feet share exactly one horizontal ground baseline, each has a credible broad complete masonry foundation. They belong to one ruined working site, but NO beam, arch, hanging rope, roof, bridge or tall wall crosses the central opening. A very low broken buried foundation trace can visually relate the halves AT the ground only, without a step or walkable deck.

Composition is very wide and low: overall visible width about 3.4 times its maximum height. Each flank occupies at most about one sixth of the total width. The middle TWO THIRDS of the full composition are genuinely transparent empty air from well above the structures down nearly to the ground. No hanging signs or foliage fill the opening. The two broad complete roots are at the far left and far right; center has NO rocks or grass islands above the ground. We need broad calm material planes and a strong changing skyline, visibly different left and right. At game scale the monumental forms must read before cracks, vines or rivets. No tiny assemblage of enlarged props.

Match the references only in painterly limestone/wood/copper material vocabulary: warm upper-left sunlight, broad cream stone faces with cool gray-lilac shadow, sparse muted olive grass naturally rooted in a few cracks. Subdued material contrast and sparse matte copper, not glowing gold. Keep the center and ground quiet so a moving player, enemy attacks, projectiles and colored danger telegraphs remain dominant. Brush-built shapes, convincing volume, imperfect natural edges, lost edges in shadow; no black outline, no photoreal render, no polished plastic, no uniform micro-texture.

NO clocks, clock faces, giant gears used as targets, bells, windmills, Gothic arches, cathedral gates, imitation of Hollow Knight, active red lamps, magic glow, sky, distant mountains, background color wash, ground shadow painted onto transparent air, floor plane receding in perspective, platforms, doors or horizontal ledges implying extra gameplay. Orthographic side elevation, restrained depth only in bevels and overlaps. Deliver only the one complete original transparent composition, not labels, sketches, panels, rulers or text. Do not recreate source silhouettes or their visible preview background.
